name: Laplace-Diophantine Domain Obfuscation
description: This method replaces the explicit binary domain and algebraic edge constraint with a continuous-time interaction function evaluated via a Laplace transform. The transform evaluates to a symmetric Diophantine equation ($p_u^4 + p_v^4 = 17$) whose only positive integer solutions are $(1, 2)$ and $(2, 1)$. This forces models to perform symbolic calculus and integer number theory just to uncover the underlying bipartite graph structure, preventing surface-level pattern matching to 2-coloring.
